about: The order tags are shown in, one table for both comparators: compareTagNames / sortedTags (web/common/vocabulary.js, checked by tests/frontend/tag-order.test.mjs) and tag_sort_key (tagpup/core/vocabulary.py, checked by tests/test_tag_order.py). Each case lists the tags as given and the order they are shown in: case and accents ignored, digits read as numbers, then the exact spelling; a path is compared one level at a time, a shorter path before its longer. Only orders the ICU collator and the Python key agree on belong here.

cases.name: case is ignored, so apple comes before Zoo
digits are numbers, so Trip 3 comes before Trip 10
accents are ignored, then the exact spelling breaks the tie
names equal but for case: the exact spelling decides, capitals first
a path is compared a level at a time, as the tag editor's tree is
levels are read as numbers too
a symbol comes before a digit, a digit before a letter
numbers equal in value: the exact spelling decides, a prefix comes first
letters with a stroke sort with their plain letter
a sharp s is read as ss
a space, an underscore and a hyphen come before letters, in that order
a shorter word before a longer, a digit before a letter
people, as the pickers list them: leaf names
